name: Cardiac Atlas — procedural educational heart

coordinates.origin: idealized near ventricular mid-base; not a patient coordinate

phase.reference: end-diastole; atrial systole begins at cycle origin

geometry_export: exports/anatomy_meshes.json will contain object names, stable anatomy IDs, vertices in Blender units, triangle faces and labels; exact reference-phase closed full geometry. Cutaway presentation objects excluded.
disclaimer: Idealized educational anatomy; not scan-derived, clinically validated, biomechanical, CFD, or calibrated imaging simulation. Individual anatomical variation and many microstructures omitted.

septa.source: heart_geometry.SEPTUM and septum_inside; pool priority removes any neighboring cavity overlap

overlap_priority: Blood pools take priority over myocardial walls/septa. Imaging sampling of vessel lumens approximates transported tube meshes by centerline segments. Anatomical regions can overlap geometrically; no cross-circuit pool overlap at reference 1mm voxel centers.
model_status: Idealized reference geometry; dimensions/volumes are not normative adult values. All10 reference meshes pass edge manifold QA, see exports/mesh_QA.json.
